name: Gigora Order Paste
author: gigora

sections.description:
Gigora Order Paste helps authorized WooCommerce store staff parse customer messages, review the extracted customer and product details, and create editable orders.

Features include:

  • Bangla, English, and Banglish message parsing.
  • Product and SKU matching with custom aliases.
  • Single and bulk order workflows.
  • Duplicate-order warnings.
  • Customer history, logs, and configurable validation.
  • High-Performance Order Storage compatibility.

The plugin requires WooCommerce.

All locally implemented plugin functionality is available without a license, activation, registration, payment, subscription, renewal, quota, or external-server connection.

External services

Gigora Order Paste includes an optional support-registration screen. It can connect to the Gigora Support Server at https://gigora.com.bd only when an authorized administrator reviews the disclosure, checks the consent box, and clicks Register for Support, Verify Registration, or Disconnect Support.

The support connection is not required for any plugin feature. The plugin does not automatically contact the support server, does not run scheduled support verification, and does not lock, unlock, enable, disable, or restrict local functionality based on support-registration status.

When the administrator explicitly consents and runs a support action, the following information is sent:

  • Support key and support email entered by the administrator.
  • Product code.
  • Website domain, site URL, and home URL.
  • Random installation ID generated by the plugin.
  • Plugin version, WordPress version, PHP version, and WooCommerce version when available.
  • Request timestamp and a random request nonce.
  • Standard connection metadata, such as the site server IP address, may be received by the remote server as part of the network request.

Customer messages, WooCommerce orders, customer names, addresses, phone numbers, products, and payment data are not sent to the support service.

Service terms: https://gigora.com.bd/terms

Privacy policy: https://gigora.com.bd/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the gigora-order-paste folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Gigora Order Paste in the WordPress dashboard.
  4. Configure the plugin and begin using it. Support registration is optional.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin create orders without review?

No. Parsed orders remain editable and must pass validation before creation.

Does it support WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. The plugin declares compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

Is support registration required?

No. All local features remain fully available without support registration. Registration is used only to help Gigora identify an installation during support management.

Does the plugin contact Gigora automatically?

No. The plugin contacts the Gigora Support Server only after an administrator explicitly checks the consent box and clicks a support action.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Replaced raw plugin-screen JavaScript output with a script loaded through wp_enqueue_script().
  • Replaced legacy JavaScript-template wrapper tags with native HTML template elements.
  • Updated the declared Gigora terms and privacy URLs.

1.0.2

  • Removed all license-based feature gates, redirects, and order-creation restrictions.
  • Removed automatic and scheduled remote license verification.
  • Changed license activation into optional support registration only.
  • Added explicit consent before every support-server connection.
  • Added a complete external-service data disclosure with terms and privacy links.
  • Confirmed that customer and order data remain local.

1.0.1

  • Added GPL-compatible plugin and readme license metadata.
  • Removed the custom WordPress update routine for WordPress.org compliance.
  • Added translator comments for placeholder strings.
  • Hardened request sanitization and custom-table SQL identifiers.
  • Reworked CSV export to avoid direct filesystem functions.
  • Added a WordPress.org-compatible readme file.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
